proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ X Y hX hY
  have key : ∀ t : WithLp 2 (ℝ × ℝ), MeasureTheory.charFun (P.map (fun ω => WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω, Y ω))) t = ∫ ω, Complex.exp (((t.ofLp.1 * X ω + t.ofLp.2 * Y ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂P := by
    intro t
    rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_apply, MeasureTheory.integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    simp only [WithLp.prod_inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_charFun_prod hX.aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable]
  constructor
  · intro h s t
    have := h (WithLp.toLp 2 (s, t))
    rw [key] at this
    exact this
  · intro h t
    rw [key]
    exact h t.ofLp.1 t.ofLp.2
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X Y : Ω → ℝ), Measurable X → Measurable Y → (ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y P ↔ ∀ s t : ℝ, ∫ ω, Complex.exp (((s * X ω + t * Y ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂P = MeasureTheory.charFun (P.map X) s * MeasureTheory.charFun (P.map Y) t)
